title: Eclipse of the Void
hook: When the sun dies in 2026, the darkness awakens.
story_text: When the moon swallows the sun on August 12, 2026, the world falls into an eerie, blood‑red twilight. Power grids flicker, phones die, and a distant radio whispers a warning no one can hear. In a deserted observatory, Dr. Alvarez races against the darkness, only to discover the eclipse hides something far older than any myth. As the shadow spreads, reality fractures—what you thought was safe becomes the deepest terror of your life.
call_to_action: Will you be ready when the shadow reaches you? Comment below!
